description:
Has two patches:
1. Optional Canon ID Login: Allows you to bypass the compulsory Canon-ID login
2. Choose Canon ID sign-in browser: By default, the login option opens in Chrome. This patch changes the browser to one of your liking (like Firefox). 

Use this Canon Connect APK: https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/canon-inc/canon-camera-connect/canon-camera-connect-3-6-11-7-release/canon-camera-connect-3-6-11-7-android-apk-download/

patches.description: Use the selected Custom Tabs browser for both service binding and browser launch.
